title: The mountains of metal melt, and the valley cannot be filled
summary_md: The angel tells Enoch what the six mountains of metal are for, and then what becomes of them when the Elect One stands up: *And he said unto me: ‘All these things which thou hast seen shall serve the dominion of His Anointed that he may be potent and mighty on the earth.’* (1 Enoch 52:4), *And these mountains which thine eyes have seen, The mountain of iron, and the mountain of copper, and the mountain of silver, And the mountain of gold, and the mountain of soft metal, and the mountain of lead, All these shall be in the presence of the Elect One As wax before the fire, And like the water which streams down from above [upon those mountains], And they shall become powerless before his feet.* (1 Enoch 52:6). Everything the kingdoms of this age build their strength out of runs like wax and streams away like water the moment the Anointed appears. Zechariah said the same thing about the mountain that stood in front of the house of Yahuah: *Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.* (Zechariah 4:7). Then the vision turns to the valley the melted mountains leave behind, and the kings of the earth come to it with their tribute: *There mine eyes saw a deep valley with open mouths, and all who dwell on the earth and sea and islands shall bring to him gifts and presents and tokens of homage, but that deep valley shall not become full.* (1 Enoch 53:1). No amount of gold or silver bought from the mountains that melted can fill that valley, because the chapter had already said *none shall be saved, Either by gold or by silver* (1 Enoch 52:7). The strength of the nations is spent on the day the Elect One shows his face, and the valley that swallows their offerings never fills.
note: 52:4 and 52:6 were invented quotes; re-formed on the live 52:4/52:6 (metals melt before the Elect One) and the live 53:1 valley; Zechariah kept; title changed since the live valley is the unfillable one, not a dwelling of the elect.

title: The angels of punishment prepare the instruments of Satan for the kings and mighty
summary_md: Enoch sees the executioners at their work and asks who the instruments are being made for: *For I saw all the angels of punishment abiding (there) and preparing all the instruments of Satan.* (1 Enoch 53:3), *And I asked the angel of peace who went with me: ‘For whom are they preparing these instruments?’* (1 Enoch 53:4), *And he said unto me: ‘They prepare these for the kings and the mighty of this earth, that they may thereby be destroyed.* (1 Enoch 53:5). The instruments are forged for the great because they ruled the earth and oppressed the ones who belonged to Yahuah, and the Son of Adam is the one who pulls them down: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.* (1 Enoch 46:4). Isaiah had already said the furnace was built for a king: *For Tophet is ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared; he hath made it deep and large: the pile thereof is fire and much wood; the breath of Yahuah (LORD), like a stream of brimstone, doth kindle it.* (Isaiah 30:33). And the Son of Adam in the Gospels sends out the same angels Enoch watched at their forge: *The Son of Adam shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;* (Matthew 13:41), *And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.* (Matthew 13:42). The title is the same in both books, Son of Adam, the one Enoch saw enthroned. The Apocrypha measures the sentence to the office held: *For mercy will soon pardon the meanest: but mighty men shall be mightily tormented.* (Wisdom of Solomon 6:6), and the Revelation shows the last instrument fall on the chief of the mighty: *These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.* (Revelation 19:20). Once the kings are dealt with, the chapter says the congregation of the Elect One comes into the open and is hindered no more: *And after this the Righteous and Elect One shall cause the house of his congregation to appear: henceforth they shall be no more hindered in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 53:6).
note: 53:4/53:6 were corrupt-text quotes; re-quoted live 53:3-5 and 46:4, added live 53:6 (anchor end); canon witnesses kept.

title: The Darkness Past — the Light Established Forever
summary_md: The third Parable opens on a light that does not end. The righteous are told the night is already behind them: *And after this it shall be said to the holy in heaven That they should seek out the secrets of righteousness, the heritage of faith: For it has become bright as the sun upon earth, And the darkness is past.* (1 Enoch 58:5), *And there shall be a light that never endeth, And to a limit (lit. ‘number’) of days they shall not come, For the darkness shall first have been destroyed, [And the light established before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits] And the light of uprightness established for ever before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 58:6). Notice the order Enoch gives it. The darkness is destroyed first, and only then is the light set up for ever; the one has to go before the other can stand. John saw the same city with no night in it: *And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day: for there shall be no night there.* (Revelation 21:25), and Isaiah had said it long before either of them: *Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself: for Yahuah (LORD) shall be thine everlasting light, and the days of thy mourning shall be ended.* (Isaiah 60:20). The destruction of the darkness is the same judgement that ends the night the Watchers brought in, and what it leaves standing is the order Yahuah set from the beginning, an unending day for the righteous and the elect.
note: 58:6 was quoted in invented words; re-quoted live 58:5-6; Revelation and Isaiah kept.

title: The secret of the lightnings — a blessing or a curse
summary_md: Enoch is shown the hidden order behind the storm: *[In those days mine eyes saw the secrets of the lightnings, and of the lights, and the judgements they execute (lit. ‘their judgement’): and they lighten for a blessing or a curse as Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits willeth.* (1 Enoch 59:1). The lightning is not loose power running wild; it is a servant under orders, which is exactly what the Tanakh had already confessed when it said Yahuah appointed *a way for the lightning of the thunder:* (Job 28:26), that *he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.* (Jeremiah 10:13), and again that *he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.* (Psalm 135:7). Enoch had already been shown the same chambers earlier in the Parables: *And there mine eyes saw the secrets of the lightning and of the thunder, and the secrets of the winds, how they are divided to blow over the earth, and the secrets of the clouds and dew, and there I saw from whence they proceed in that place and from whence they saturate the dusty earth.* (1 Enoch 41:3). So the lightning that flashes for blessing or for curse at the word of the Creator is the canon's own teaching, and Enoch is simply shown the storehouse it comes out of. It ain't new.
note: Mechanical re-quote stood; smoothed the prose and quoted 41:3 in full.

title: The sun and moon keep faith in their orbit; the winds are weighed
summary_md: Enoch sees the luminaries hold the course they were given and never stray from it: *And I saw the chambers of the sun and moon, whence they proceed and whither they come again, and their glorious return, and how one is superior to the other, and their stately orbit, and how they do not leave their orbit, and they add nothing to their orbit and they take nothing from it, and they keep faith with each other, in accordance with the oath by which they are bound together.* (1 Enoch 41:5), *And first the sun goes forth and traverses his path according to the commandment of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, and mighty is His name for ever and ever.* (1 Enoch 41:6). The lights keep faith because they are bound by an oath, and the sun goes out by commandment, not by its own will. The winds are under the same hand, and Enoch is shown how they are measured out before they ever blow: *And the chambers of the winds, and how the winds are divided, and how they are weighed, and (how) the portals of the winds are reckoned, each according to the power of the wind, and the power of the lights of the moon, and according to the power that is fitting: and the divisions of the stars according to their names, and how all the divisions are divided.* (1 Enoch 60:12). The Psalmist names the same treasury the wind is brought out of: *He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.* (Psalm 135:7). The sun and moon that keep faith and the winds that are weighed before they go out are one obedient creation under one Creator, and the chapter that follows shows the lightnings serving the same way, for a blessing or a curse as he wills. It ain't new.
note: 59:4-6 do not exist in the live text (the chapter is three verses on the lightnings); re-formed on live 41:5-6 and 60:12, Psalm kept; title adjusted.

title: The Head of Days seats the Elect One on the throne of glory
summary_md: The Father enthrones the Son to judge: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.* (1 Enoch 61:8), *And when he shall lift up his countenance To judge their secret ways according to the word of the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And their path according to the way of the righteous judgement of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, Then shall they all with one voice speak and bless, And glorify and extol and sanctify the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 61:9). Enoch says it again in the very next chapter, where the kings are commanded to look and recognize him, and the Father seats him a second time in the telling: *And thus Yahuah (Lord) commanded the kings and the mighty and the exalted, and those who dwell on the earth, and said: ‘Open your eyes and lift up your horns if ye are able to recognize the Elect One.’* (1 Enoch 62:1), *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits seated him on the throne of His glory, And the spirit of righteousness was poured out upon him, And the word of his mouth slays all the sinners, And all the unrighteous are destroyed from before his face.* (1 Enoch 62:2). Yahusha (Jesus) claims that throne as his own: *When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:* (Matthew 25:31). Daniel saw the same scene, and he kept the comparative in it: *I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.* (Daniel 7:13). Daniel sees one *like* the Son of Adam, because the one who rides the clouds took on flesh and looked like a man; Enoch names that same one the Elect One, set under the Head of Days and seated on his throne, blessed together with him and never confused with him.
note: Draft had quoted 61:8 twice in place of 62:1; replaced with live 62:1-2; smoothed the prose.

title: The whole host of heaven bless with one voice
summary_md: When the Elect One lifts up his countenance to judge, all of heaven answers as one: *And He will summon all the host of the heavens, and all the holy ones above, and the host of Elohim (God), the Cherubin, Seraphin and Ophannin, and all the angels of power, and all the angels of principalities, and the Elect One, and the other powers on the earth (and) over the water.* (1 Enoch 61:10), *On that day shall raise one voice, and bless and glorify and exalt in the spirit of faith, and in the spirit of wisdom, and in the spirit of patience, and in the spirit of mercy, and in the spirit of judgement and of peace, and in the spirit of goodness, and shall all say with one voice: "Blessed is He, and may the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits be blessed for ever and ever."* (1 Enoch 61:11). John saw that same worship around the throne, the living creatures that never stop: *And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Yahuah Elohim (Lord God) Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.* (Revelation 4:8). Daniel numbered the host that stands before the Head of Days when the court sits: *A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.* (Daniel 7:10). The Cherubin, Seraphin and Ophannin Enoch lists are the living creatures John saw and the ten thousand times ten thousand Daniel counted, and what they are doing in every one of these books is the same thing, blessing the name of the Father with one voice.
note: Mechanical re-quote stood; 61:11 quoted in full; spellings in the prose matched to the live verse.

title: This is the Son of Adam — named, born unto righteousness
summary_md: Where Daniel and the Gospels say *one like the Son of Adam*, Enoch drops the veil and names him plainly. The angel tells Enoch who he is: *And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* (1 Enoch 46:3), and at the end of the Parables says it again: *And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’* (1 Enoch 71:14). He was named before anything was made: *Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits* (1 Enoch 48:3), and this chapter says why the kings only recognize him now: *For from the beginning the Son of Adam was hidden, And the El Elyon (Most High) preserved him in the presence of His might, And revealed him to the elect.* (1 Enoch 62:7). The Father chooses him, names him, hides him, and reveals him to the elect, and all of that is done before anyone confesses anything. The Gospel says the same thing without the comparative, because by then the Word had come in flesh: *Hereafter shall ye see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven* (Matthew 26:64). It ain't new.
note: Draft quoted 46:3 twice; reordered around live 46:3, 71:14, 48:3 and added the anchor's 62:7.

title: The Elect One Seated to Judge
summary_md: The Father seats the Son, and the verdict goes out by the word of his mouth: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits seated him on the throne of His glory, And the spirit of righteousness was poured out upon him, And the word of his mouth slays all the sinners, And all the unrighteous are destroyed from before his face.* (1 Enoch 62:2). This chapter is what that judgement looks like from the side of the kings. They ask for a little respite so they can worship and confess, and the answer they get is the ordinance itself: *And after that their faces shall be filled with darkness And shame before that Son of Adam, And they shall be driven from his presence, And the sword shall abide before his face in their midst.* (1 Enoch 63:11), *Thus spake Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: ‘This is the ordinance and judgement with respect to the mighty and the kings and the exalted and those who possess the earth before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.’* (1 Enoch 63:12). The Head of Days is the Father, and the one he seats is the Son; Daniel saw the same thing and kept the comparative in his telling, *behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him* (Daniel 7:13), one *like* the Son of Adam because the cloud-rider took on flesh, while Enoch names him outright. To him *was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him* (Daniel 7:14). The slaying word is the Messiah's own: *he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked* (Isaiah 11:4), *Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel* (Psalm 2:9), and Yahusha (Jesus) confirms the seat, *When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:* (Matthew 25:31). The Son is set under the Father and worshipped with him, and he is not the Father, not a created angel, and not a mere man.
note: 63:2/63:5 were invented; the live 63 is the kings' confession, so the seating is quoted from 62:2 and the chapter's own 63:11-12 ordinance carries the judgement; canon kept.

title: Terror of the Kings Before the Son of Adam
summary_md: When the proud finally see the one they mocked, terror takes hold of them: *And one portion of them shall look on the other, And they shall be terrified, And they shall be downcast of countenance, And pain shall seize them, When they see that Son of Adam Sitting on the throne of his glory.* (1 Enoch 62:5). This chapter lets us hear what they say once it is too late: *And now we long for a little rest but find it not: We follow hard upon and obtain (it) not: And light has vanished from before us, And darkness is our dwelling-place for ever and ever:* (1 Enoch 63:6), *For we have not believed before Him Nor glorified the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, [nor glorified our Lord] But our hope was in the sceptre of our kingdom, And in our glory.* (1 Enoch 63:7), *And in the day of our suffering and tribulation He saves us not, And we find no respite for confession That our Lord is true in all His works, and in His judgements and His justice, And His judgements have no respect of persons.* (1 Enoch 63:8). John saw the same rout: *And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;* (Revelation 6:15), crying *to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb:* (Revelation 6:16), *For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?* (Revelation 6:17). The Wisdom of Solomon gives the wicked the same late speech as they look on the righteous one they derided: *And they repenting and groaning for anguish of spirit shall say within themselves, This was he, whom we had sometimes in derision, and a proverb of reproach:* (Wisdom of Solomon 5:3), *What has pride profited us? or what good has riches with our vaunting brought us?* (Wisdom of Solomon 5:8). The same kings, the same mighty men who possessed the earth, and the same dread that comes a day too late. It ain't new.
note: 63:7-8 quoted in invented words; re-quoted the live 63:6-8 (the kings' lament) with 62:5; canon kept.

title: Driven From the Earth, Perished For Ever
summary_md: The sentence is final; the sinners are swept off the earth and do not come back. *And he sat on the throne of his glory, And the sum of judgement was given unto the Son of Adam, And he caused the sinners to pass away and be destroyed from off the face of the earth, And those who have led the world astray.* (1 Enoch 69:27), *And their hands commit lawless deeds, And the sinners devour all whom they lawlessly oppress: Yet the sinners shall be destroyed before the face of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And they shall be banished from off the face of His earth, And they shall perish for ever and ever.* (1 Enoch 53:2). This chapter has the kings say it of themselves: *And we pass away from before His face on account of our works, And all our sins are reckoned up in righteousness.* (1 Enoch 63:9), *Now they shall say unto themselves: ‘Our souls are full of unrighteous gain, but it does not prevent us from descending from the midst thereof into the burden of Sheol.’* (1 Enoch 63:10). It is the same Son of Adam Enoch was shown earlier in the Parables, *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.* (1 Enoch 46:4), and the reason is given with it: *[And he shall put down the kings from their thrones and kingdoms] Because they do not extol and praise Him, Nor humbly acknowledge whence the kingdom was bestowed upon them.* (1 Enoch 46:5). Wisdom has the wicked name the cause of their ruin in their own words: *Therefore have we erred from the way of truth, and the light of righteousness has not shined to us, and the sun of righteousness rose not upon us.* (Wisdom of Solomon 5:6). And Psalm 2 holds out the one escape the kings refused while there was still time: *Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.* (Psalm 2:12). The everlasting perishing falls on the ones who led the world astray from his way, not on the ones who kept it.
note: Mechanical re-quote stood; added the chapter's own 63:9-10 and plainened the close.

title: The fallen angels reserved in chains until the day of judgement
summary_md: In the vision of the Noah fragments Enoch is shown the hidden place of the rebel Watchers and told who they are: *And other forms I saw hidden in that place.* (1 Enoch 64:1), *I heard the voice of the angel saying: ‘These are the angels who descended to the earth, and revealed what was hidden to the children of men and seduced the children of men into committing sin.’* (1 Enoch 64:2). The sentence that holds them there was given long before, in the first vision: *And when their sons have slain one another, and they have seen the destruction of their beloved ones, bind them fast for seventy generations in the valleys of the earth, till the day of their judgement and of their consummation, till the judgement that is for ever and ever is consummated.* (1 Enoch 10:12), *In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.* (1 Enoch 10:13). The canon carries the same picture forward without changing a line of it: *And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.* (Jude 1:6). Jude quotes Enoch openly a few verses later, and he holds the same Watchers reserved for the same great day. Peter says it again: *For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;* (2 Peter 2:4). And the pattern of a binding that waits for a judgement surfaces one last time at the end, when John sees that *he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years,* (Revelation 20:2). The Watchers are not loose. They are prisoners under sentence, kept until the day appointed, and every book in the library that touches them says so.
note: 64:1-3 quotes were from the corrupt text; the live chapter is two verses, quoted in full, with the sentence from live 10:12-13; Jude, Peter, Revelation kept.

title: The spirits of the giants begotten by the fallen angels
summary_md: The angels hidden in that place are named for Enoch as the ones who came down and taught sin: *I heard the voice of the angel saying: ‘These are the angels who descended to the earth, and revealed what was hidden to the children of men and seduced the children of men into committing sin.’* (1 Enoch 64:2). Their sons are a separate company with a separate fate, and the first vision had already laid it out: *And now, the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth, and on the earth shall be their dwelling.* (1 Enoch 15:8), *Evil spirits have proceeded from their bodies; because they are born from men and from the holy Watchers is their beginning and primal origin; they shall be evil spirits on earth, and evil spirits shall they be called.* (1 Enoch 15:9). That is the Genesis account said plainly: *There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of Elohim (God) came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.* (Genesis 6:4). Jubilees tells the same descent and says the women *bare to them sons and they were giants* (Jubilees 5:1), whose spirits wait for *the day of the great condemnation when judgment is executed on all those who have corrupted their ways* (Jubilees 5:10). Enoch's earlier word explains why those spirits still roam and trouble the earth until that day: *From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."* (1 Enoch 16:1). The giants are not a fable. They are the corrupted seed Genesis names and Enoch unfolds, and their spirits are the trouble on the earth until the judgement.
note: 64:4 was invented; re-formed on live 64:2 and 15:8-9 (the giants' spirits), 16:1 re-anchored; Genesis and Jubilees kept.

title: The two hundred who descended in the days of Jared on Mount Hermon
summary_md: The angel tells Enoch who the hidden ones are: *I heard the voice of the angel saying: ‘These are the angels who descended to the earth, and revealed what was hidden to the children of men and seduced the children of men into committing sin.’* (1 Enoch 64:2). The book had already recorded that descent at the start, with the mountain, the generation, and the oath: *And they were in all two hundred; who descended in the days of Jared on the summit of Mount Hermon, and they called it Mount Hermon, because they had sworn and bound themselves by mutual imprecations upon it.* (1 Enoch 6:6), *And these are the names of their leaders: Samîazâz, their leader, Arâkîba, Râmêêl, Kôkabîêl, Tâmîêl, Râmîêl, Dânêl, Êzêqêêl, Barâqîjâl, Asâêl, Armârôs, Batârêl, Anânêl, Zaqîêl, Samsâpêêl, Satarêl, Tûrêl, Jômjâêl, Sariêl.* (1 Enoch 6:7). Their sentence was handed down there too: *And when their sons have slain one another, and they have seen the destruction of their beloved ones, bind them fast for seventy generations in the valleys of the earth, till the day of their judgement and of their consummation, till the judgement that is for ever and ever is consummated.* (1 Enoch 10:12). Genesis opens the same door without naming the mountain: *And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born unto them, That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.* (Genesis 6:1-2). And Isaiah sees that same host gathered and shut up *in that day*: *And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah (LORD) shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high* (Isaiah 24:21). The crime of the Watchers was leaving the place they were given and teaching men what was hidden, and the judgement waiting for them is for that breach of the Creator's order. It ain't new.
note: 64:6 was invented; re-formed on live 64:2, 6:6-7, 10:12; Genesis and Isaiah kept.

title: The earth sunk down and nigh to destruction
summary_md: Noah sees the world itself giving way under the weight of what has been done on it: *And in those days Noah saw the earth that it had sunk down and its destruction was nigh.* (1 Enoch 65:1), *And I said unto him: ‘Tell me what it is that is falling out on the earth that the earth is in such evil plight and shaken, lest perchance I shall perish with it?’* (1 Enoch 65:3). This is Genesis told from inside the house of the man who built the ark. Moses names the same ruin: *The earth also was corrupt before Elohim (God), and the earth was filled with violence.* (Genesis 6:11), *And Elohim (God) looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.* (Genesis 6:12), so that *Yahuah (LORD) said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth* (Genesis 6:7). Jubilees records the same flood of lawlessness that wearied the ground: *And lawlessness increased on the earth and all flesh corrupted its way... and they began to devour each other* (Jubilees 5:2). And Enoch gives Noah the reason straight from the throne: *And a command has gone forth from the presence of Yahuah (Lord) concerning those who dwell on the earth that their ruin is accomplished because they have learnt all the secrets of the angels, and all the violence of the Satans, and all their powers—the most secret ones—and all the power of those who practise sorcery, and the power of witchcraft, and the power of those who make molten images for the whole earth:* (1 Enoch 65:6). The earth sinks because the people on it took up what the angels taught. The judgement falls on a creation defiled, and the order the Creator set for it is the thing being vindicated, not the thing being set aside.
note: 65:3 was quoted in invented words; re-quoted live 65:1, 65:3 and added live 65:6 (the reason); Genesis and Jubilees kept.

title: Noah cries to Enoch; Enoch brings back the word of judgement
summary_md: Noah runs to the ends of the earth and cries out to the grandfather who was taken: *And he arose from thence and went to the ends of the earth, and cried aloud to his grandfather Enoch: and Noah said three times with an embittered voice: ‘Hear me, hear me, hear me.’* (1 Enoch 65:2). Enoch comes to him, asks why he weeps, and gives him the answer he has carried down from the presence of Yahuah: *And a command has gone forth from the presence of Yahuah (Lord) concerning those who dwell on the earth that their ruin is accomplished because they have learnt all the secrets of the angels, and all the violence of the Satans, and all their powers—the most secret ones—and all the power of those who practise sorcery, and the power of witchcraft, and the power of those who make molten images for the whole earth:* (1 Enoch 65:6), *And after that my grandfather Enoch took hold of me by my hand and raised me up, and said unto me: ‘Go, for I have asked Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits as touching this commotion on the earth.* (1 Enoch 65:9), *And He said unto me: “Because of their unrighteousness their judgement has been determined upon and shall not be withheld by Me for ever. Because of the sorceries which they have searched out and learnt, the earth and those who dwell upon it shall be destroyed.”* (1 Enoch 65:10). The man who walked with Elohim and was taken is still the one carrying the warning, and the warning is that the judgement has been decided and will not be held back. Peter sets the same word against the same scoffers: *whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.* (2 Peter 2:3). And Yahusha (Jesus) hangs the last days on these very days of Noah, when men ate and drank and knew nothing until the flood came. The judgement is announced, it is patient, and it does not slumber.
note: 65:6 'did not cease to speak' was invented; re-formed on live 65:2, 65:6, 65:9-10 (Enoch's answer to Noah); Peter kept; title adjusted.

title: The angels who descended taught mankind sin
summary_md: Enoch names the root of the ruin for Noah, and it is the teaching of the angels who came down: *And a command has gone forth from the presence of Yahuah (Lord) concerning those who dwell on the earth that their ruin is accomplished because they have learnt all the secrets of the angels, and all the violence of the Satans, and all their powers—the most secret ones—and all the power of those who practise sorcery, and the power of witchcraft, and the power of those who make molten images for the whole earth:* (1 Enoch 65:6), *And He said unto me: “Because of their unrighteousness their judgement has been determined upon and shall not be withheld by Me for ever. Because of the sorceries which they have searched out and learnt, the earth and those who dwell upon it shall be destroyed.”* (1 Enoch 65:10). That is Enoch's own earlier testimony brought forward to Noah's door: *And Azâzêl taught men to make swords, and knives, and shields, and breastplates, and made known to them the metals of the earth and the art of working them, and bracelets, and ornaments, and the use of antimony, and the beautifying of the eyelids, and all kinds of costly stones, and all colouring tinctures.* (1 Enoch 8:1), *And there arose much godlessness, and they committed fornication, and they were led astray, and became corrupt in all their ways.* (1 Enoch 8:2). Jubilees tells the same descent, when *the angels of Elohim (God) saw them... and they took themselves wives of all whom they chose, and they bare to them sons and they were giants.* (Jubilees 5:1). Jude and Peter carry it into the apostolic writings: *And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.* (Jude 1:6), *For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment* (2 Peter 2:4). The sin of the Watchers was teaching men what was hidden, and what they sowed runs straight into the flood Noah is about to live through.
note: 65:9-10 were invented; re-formed on live 65:6, 65:10 and 8:1-2; Jubilees, Jude, Peter kept.

title: The earth cleansed; all made righteous to worship
summary_md: Past the judgement, Enoch's word to Noah ends on the seed that comes through it: *And He has destined thy name to be among the holy, And will preserve thee amongst those who dwell on the earth, And has destined thy righteous seed both for kingship and for great honours, And from thy seed shall proceed a fountain of the righteous and holy without number for ever.’* (1 Enoch 65:12). The world that seed is kept for is the one Enoch had already been shown when the command went out to the angels: *And cleanse thou the earth from all oppression, and from all unrighteousness, and from all sin, and from all godlessness: and all the uncleanness that is wrought upon the earth destroy from off the earth.* (1 Enoch 10:20), *And all the children of men shall become righteous, and all nations shall offer adoration and shall praise Me, and all shall worship Me.* (1 Enoch 10:21), *And the earth shall be cleansed from all defilement, and from all sin, and from all punishment, and from all torment, and I will never again send (them) upon it from generation to generation and for ever.* (1 Enoch 10:22). Jubilees seals the same renewal after the flood: *And He made for all His works a new and righteous nature, so that they should not sin in their whole nature for ever, but should be all righteous each in his kind alway.* (Jubilees 5:11), and Yahuah vows *I will not again curse the ground any more for man's sake* (Genesis 8:21). The cleansing is the Creator restoring his own order on the earth, and the fountain of the righteous that comes out of Noah is the people he restores it for.
note: 65:12-13 'cleansed' quotes were the corrupt text; the live 65:12 is Noah's seed, so the thread now runs 65:12 → 10:20-22; Jubilees and Genesis kept.

title: Noah preserved; a fountain of the righteous from his seed
summary_md: Enoch's last word to Noah is that he has been set apart before the waters ever rise: *And these—they have no place of repentance for ever, because they have shown them what was hidden, and they are the damned: but as for thee, my son, Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits knows that thou art pure, and guiltless of this reproach concerning the secrets.* (1 Enoch 65:11), *And He has destined thy name to be among the holy, And will preserve thee amongst those who dwell on the earth, And has destined thy righteous seed both for kingship and for great honours, And from thy seed shall proceed a fountain of the righteous and holy without number for ever.’* (1 Enoch 65:12). Noah is not preserved because he picked himself out. Moses says grace came first: *But Noah found grace in the eyes of Yahuah (LORD).* (Genesis 6:8), and then describes the walk that grace produced: *Noah was a just man and perfect in his generations, and Noah walked with Elohim (God).* (Genesis 6:9). Jubilees keeps the same order: *no man’s person was accepted save that of Noah alone; for his person was accepted in behalf of his sons, whom Elohim (God) saved from the waters of the flood on his account; for his heart was righteous in all his ways* (Jubilees 5:19). His name was destined among the holy and his seed was destined for kingship before the flood came, and the righteousness he walked out was the fruit of that, never the price of it.
note: 65:14 does not exist; re-formed on live 65:11-12; Genesis and Jubilees kept; title adjusted to the live verse.

title: The angels over the waters, held in check until the word
summary_md: Enoch sees the executioners of the deluge standing ready and then held back: *And after that he showed me the angels of punishment who are prepared to come and let loose all the powers of the waters which are beneath in the earth in order to bring judgement and destruction on all who [abide and] dwell on the earth.* (1 Enoch 66:1), *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits gave commandment to the angels who were going forth, that they should not cause the waters to rise but should hold them in check; for those angels were over the powers of the waters.* (1 Enoch 66:2). This is the canon's own flood, told from the side of the ones who hold the deep until they are told to let it go: *In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened* (Genesis 7:11). The Parables had already named both chambers a few chapters earlier: *And in those days shall punishment come from Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, and He will open all the chambers of waters which are above the heavens, and of the fountains which are beneath the earth* (1 Enoch 54:7). The deep above and the deep below are the very waters Genesis opens. And the picture of angels set over the elements, holding them until the word is given, runs straight to John's vision of a judgement held in check: *And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree* (Revelation 7:1). The messengers stand ready, and nothing is loosed until the Creator commands it. It ain't new.
note: 66:4 does not exist; re-quoted live 66:1-2 (the holding in check); Genesis, 54:7, Revelation kept.

title: The waters loosed on the ungodly, and then sworn never again
summary_md: The angels of punishment are shown to Enoch with the waters in their hands, and what the waters are for is said plainly: *And after that he showed me the angels of punishment who are prepared to come and let loose all the powers of the waters which are beneath in the earth in order to bring judgement and destruction on all who [abide and] dwell on the earth.* (1 Enoch 66:1). That is exactly how the canon frames the deluge, a flood on the world of the ungodly with the one righteous man carried through it: *And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly* (2 Peter 2:5). The waters went out by command and they were stopped by command: *The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained* (Genesis 8:2), the same fountains and windows Genesis opened in the six hundredth year of Noah, shut again. And the Parables carry the oath that followed, the Head of Days swearing by his own name that he will not do it twice: *And He sware by His great name: ‘Henceforth I will not do so to all who dwell on the earth, and I will set a sign in the heaven: and this shall be a pledge of good faith between Me and them for ever, so long as heaven is above the earth. And this is in accordance with My command.* (1 Enoch 55:2). The next verse keeps the judgement itself alive even while the flood is sworn off: *When I have desired to take hold of them by the hand of the angels on the day of tribulation and pain because of this, I will cause My chastisement and My wrath to abide upon them, saith Elohim (God), Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 55:3). The water will not come back, but the day of tribulation will, by the hand of the same angels.
note: 66:5-6 do not exist (the live chapter is three verses); re-formed on live 66:1 and 55:2-3; Peter and Genesis kept; title adjusted.

title: The righteous and elect saved, dwelling in the light
summary_md: Where the ungodly perish, the elect are kept, and Enoch says it on the day the Son of Adam sits down: *And the righteous and elect shall be saved on that day, And they shall never thenceforward see the face of the sinners and unrighteous.* (1 Enoch 62:13), *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits will abide over them, And with that Son of Adam shall they eat And lie down and rise up for ever and ever.* (1 Enoch 62:14). The flood was the first picture of that division, the same Lord who drowns the ungodly carrying his own through: *Yahuah (Lord) knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished* (2 Peter 2:9), and the angels over the waters in this chapter were told to hold them until he said otherwise: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits gave commandment to the angels who were going forth, that they should not cause the waters to rise but should hold them in check; for those angels were over the powers of the waters.* (1 Enoch 66:2). The place the kept ones are kept for is the light the Parables sing of elsewhere: *And the righteous shall be in the light of the sun, And the elect in the light of eternal life: The days of their life shall be unending, And the days of the holy without number.* (1 Enoch 58:3), and it is the city John saw: *And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever* (Revelation 22:5). The righteous here are a preserved people. They are saved because the Most High preserves them, and they are kept in his light for ever.
note: 66:8-9 do not exist; re-formed on live 62:13-14, 66:2, 58:3; Peter and Revelation kept.

title: The fallen angels imprisoned in the burning valley
summary_md: After the promise over Noah's seed, the word turns to the angels who led the earth astray, and the sentence is given a place: *And He will imprison those angels, who have shown unrighteousness, in that burning valley which my grandfather Enoch had formerly shown to me in the west among the mountains of gold and silver and iron and soft metal and tin.* (1 Enoch 67:4), *And through its valleys proceed streams of fire, where these angels are punished who had led astray those who dwell upon the earth.* (1 Enoch 67:7). The four archangels are the ones who carry it out: *And Michael, and Gabriel, and Raphael, and Phanuel shall take hold of them on that great day, and cast them on that day into the burning furnace, that Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits may take vengeance on them for their unrighteousness in becoming subject to Satan and leading astray those who dwell on the earth.’* (1 Enoch 54:6), and the earlier word over Semjâzâ and his company set the same end: *In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.* (1 Enoch 10:13). This is the canon's own Genesis 6 rebellion held over for sentence: *And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day* (Jude 1:6), *For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment* (2 Peter 2:4). Yahusha (Jesus) uses Enoch's own furnace when he tells where the tares go: *And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth* (Matthew 13:42). And Michael says what the whole scene is for: *And I heard Michael answering and saying: ‘This judgement wherewith the angels are judged is a testimony for the kings and the mighty who possess the earth.’* (1 Enoch 67:12). The angels left the place they were given and led the earth astray, and the burning valley is the answer to that. It ain't new.
note: 67:1-2 were invented; re-formed on live 67:4, 67:7, 67:12 with 54:6 and 10:13; Jude, Peter, Matthew kept; title adjusted.

title: The earth cleansed from all corruption
summary_md: The judgement in this chapter burns in a valley under the land, and it is aimed at the ones who led the earth astray: *And when all this took place, from that fiery molten metal and from the convulsion thereof in that place, there was produced a smell of sulphur, and it was connected with those waters, and that valley of the angels who had led astray (mankind) burned beneath that land.* (1 Enoch 67:6), *And through its valleys proceed streams of fire, where these angels are punished who had led astray those who dwell upon the earth.* (1 Enoch 67:7). That fire is not the end of the story; it is how the earth is made clean. The command Enoch heard in the first vision says what the burning is for: *And cleanse thou the earth from all oppression, and from all unrighteousness, and from all sin, and from all godlessness: and all the uncleanness that is wrought upon the earth destroy from off the earth.* (1 Enoch 10:20). The prophets and the apostles look to the same cleansed creation: *For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind* (Isaiah 65:17), *Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness* (2 Peter 3:13), and John sees it done: *And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea* (Revelation 21:1). The defilement the Watchers brought in at Genesis 6 is finally undone, and the order the Creator set is what is left standing where the corruption used to be. It ain't new.
note: Mechanical re-quote stood; added the anchor's own 67:6-7 and mended the prose.

title: Two hundred who swore on Hermon — the angels who left their estate
summary_md: Michael and Raphael speak together in this chapter about a judgement so severe the angels under it melt away: *And on that day Michael answered Raphael and said: ‘The power of the spirit transports and makes me to tremble because of the severity of the judgement of the secrets, the judgement of the angels: who can endure the severe judgement which has been executed, and before which they melt away?’* (1 Enoch 68:2), and Michael will not plead for them: *And it came to pass when he stood before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, Michael said thus to Raphael: ‘I will not take their part under the eye of Yahuah (Lord); for Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits has been angry with them because they do as if they were Yahuah (Lord).* (1 Enoch 68:4). The ones under that sentence are the two hundred Enoch named at the start, with the mountain and the oath: *And they were in all two hundred; who descended in the days of Jared on the summit of Mount Hermon, and they called it Mount Hermon, because they had sworn and bound themselves by mutual imprecations upon it.* (1 Enoch 6:6). This is the canon's own Genesis 6, told in fuller detail. Moses records the descent: *That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.* (Genesis 6:2), and the offspring: *There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of Elohim (God) came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.* (Genesis 6:4). The apostles read it the same way, as a rebellion already under sentence: *And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.* (Jude 6), *For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;* (2 Peter 2:4). Jubilees carries the same descent: *the angels of Elohim (God) saw them... and they took themselves wives of all whom they chose, and they bare to them sons and they were giants.* (Jubilees 5:1). The Watchers of Enoch are the sons of Elohim of Genesis 6, and the trouble that runs through the whole earth after them began with that oath on Hermon.
note: Mechanical re-quote stood; added the live 68:2 and 68:4 so the chapter thread stands on chapter 68; mended the prose.

title: Azazel taught the arts — and the earth was filled with corruption
summary_md: The judgement Michael trembles at in this chapter was earned by teaching. Enoch records what the Watchers taught and what it bred: *And Azâzêl taught men to make swords, and knives, and shields, and breastplates, and made known to them the metals of the earth and the art of working them, and bracelets, and ornaments, and the use of antimony, and the beautifying of the eyelids, and all kinds of costly stones, and all colouring tinctures.* (1 Enoch 8:1), *Semjâzâ taught enchantments, and root-cuttings, Armârôs the resolving of enchantments, Barâqîjâl (taught) astrology, Kôkabêl the constellations, Êzêqêêl the knowledge of the clouds, Araqiêl the signs of the earth, Shamsiêl the signs of the sun, and Sariêl the course of the moon.* (1 Enoch 8:3). The fruit of it is named plainly: *And there arose much godlessness, and they committed fornication, and they were led astray, and became corrupt in all their ways.* (1 Enoch 8:2), which is the verdict of Genesis in almost the same words: *The earth also was corrupt before Elohim (God), and the earth was filled with violence.* (Genesis 6:11). Michael's reason for refusing to plead for them is that they set themselves up in the Creator's place: *for Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits has been angry with them because they do as if they were Yahuah (Lord).* (1 Enoch 68:4). And the arts they handed down, the divination and enchantment and reading of times and heavens, are the very things the Torah forbids by name: *There shall not be found among you any one that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, or that useth divination, or an observer of times, or an enchanter, or a witch,* (Deuteronomy 18:10). What the Watchers taught was never knowledge; it was a way of acting as if they were Yahuah, and the Torah draws the line exactly where they crossed it.
note: 68:7-9 do not exist; the quotes live at 8:1-3 and the anchor sits there; added live 68:4 to tie the chapter in; Genesis and Deuteronomy kept.

title: Their cry went up to heaven — the host reserved unto judgment
summary_md: The record of what the Watchers taught closes on the groan of the ruined earth: *And as men perished, they cried, and their cry went up to heaven...* (1 Enoch 8:4). That cry is not left unanswered. The judgement Michael and Raphael speak of in this chapter is the answer to it: *Therefore all that is hidden shall come upon them for ever and ever; for neither angel nor man shall have his portion (in it), but alone they have received their judgement for ever and ever.’* (1 Enoch 68:5). Isaiah saw the same sentence from the other side, the host of heaven shut up in the pit the way Enoch's Watchers are bound: *And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah (LORD) shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.* (Isaiah 24:21), *And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.* (Isaiah 24:22). Peter and Jude hold them in the same chains, reserved unto judgment, and Revelation carries the sentence to its end, when the deceiver himself is given over: *And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet are, and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever.* (Revelation 20:10). The cry that went up from the earth in Enoch's day is the cry the whole library answers with the great day of judgement. It ain't new.
note: 68:10 does not exist; the quote lives at 8:4 where the anchor sits; added live 68:5; Isaiah and Revelation kept; fixed the close that said the cry rises in chapter 68.

title: The Name of the Son of Adam revealed; he sits on the throne of glory
summary_md: The third Parable ends with the oath that holds creation together, and then with joy, because a name has been made known: *And there was great joy amongst them, And they blessed and glorified and extolled Because the name of that Son of Adam had been revealed unto them.* (1 Enoch 69:26), *And he sat on the throne of his glory, And the sum of judgement was given unto the Son of Adam, And he caused the sinners to pass away and be destroyed from off the face of the earth, And those who have led the world astray.* (1 Enoch 69:27), *And from henceforth there shall be nothing corruptible; For that Son of Adam has appeared, And has seated himself on the throne of his glory, And all evil shall pass away before his face, And the word of that Son of Adam shall go forth And be strong before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits. This is the third Parable of Enoch.* (1 Enoch 69:29). Enoch names him. He is the one who proceeds from the Head of Days, chosen and named before anything was made: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days* (1 Enoch 48:2). Daniel saw the same one, and said *like*, because the one he saw would take on flesh and look like a man while remaining the one who rides the clouds: *I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him. And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom* (Daniel 7:13-14). The Gospel drops the *like*, because by then the named one had come: *When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory* (Matthew 25:31). And the name that was hidden and then revealed is the name above every name: *Wherefore Elohim (God) also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name: That at the name of Yahusha (Jesus) every knee should bow* (Philippians 2:9-10). He is worshipped with the Father and set under him, and his name was named before the world was.
note: 69:30-33 numbering was the corrupt text; re-quoted live 69:26-27, 29 and 48:2; canon kept; smoothed.

title: The judgement of the Watchers, and the blood that filled the earth
summary_md: Michael says what the judgement of the angels is for: *And I heard Michael answering and saying: ‘This judgement wherewith the angels are judged is a testimony for the kings and the mighty who possess the earth.’* (1 Enoch 67:12). The angels' own petition had told heaven how the corruption came: *Thou seest what Azâzêl hath done, who hath taught all unrighteousness on earth and revealed the eternal secrets which were (preserved) in heaven, which men were striving to learn:* (1 Enoch 9:6), *And they have gone to the daughters of men upon the earth, and have slept with the women, and have defiled themselves, and revealed to them all kinds of sins.* (1 Enoch 9:8), *And the women have borne giants, and the whole earth has thereby been filled with blood and unrighteousness.* (1 Enoch 9:9). The Holy One says the same thing to the Watchers' faces: *And though ye were holy, spiritual, living the eternal life, you have defiled yourselves with the blood of women, and have begotten (children) with the blood of flesh, and, as the children of men, have lusted after flesh and blood as those also do who die and perish.* (1 Enoch 15:4). An earth filled with blood is the canon's own flood world: *The earth also was corrupt before Elohim (God), and the earth was filled with violence* (Genesis 6:11), *for the earth is filled with violence through them* (Genesis 6:13). Jubilees tells it the same way: *And every one sold himself to work iniquity and to shed much blood, and the earth was filled with iniquity* (Jubilees 7:23). And the cry of the slain that goes up to heaven is the cry under the altar in the Revelation: *I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of Elohim (God)... And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Yahuah (Lord), holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?* (Revelation 6:9-10). The answer is the one the third Parable closes on: *With chains shall they be bound, And in their assemblage-place of destruction shall they be imprisoned, And all their works vanish from the face of the earth.* (1 Enoch 69:28). The ones who filled the earth with blood are bound, and the ones whose blood was shed are answered.
note: 69:36-39 numbering was the corrupt text; re-quoted live 9:6, 9:8-9 (from the re-anchor), 15:4, 67:12, 69:28; canon kept; title adjusted.

title: Where the first fathers and the righteous dwell
summary_md: Enoch is taken up, and the place he is set down in has the first fathers already living in it: *And from that day I was no longer numbered amongst them: and he set me between the two winds, between the North and the West, where the angels took the cords to measure for me the place for the elect and righteous.* (1 Enoch 70:3), *And there I saw the first fathers and the righteous who from the beginning dwell in that place.* (1 Enoch 70:4). The apostolic writings name that same gathering, the fathers and the righteous made perfect in the heavenly city: *But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living Elohim (God), the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,* (Hebrews 12:22), *To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to Elohim (God) the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,* (Hebrews 12:23). The Gospel shows the righteous dead carried to the same rest by angels: *And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham's bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;* (Luke 16:22). The first fathers do not pass into nothing. The righteous whose names are written in heaven from the beginning dwell in the place Enoch was allowed to see, and the angels measure that place out with cords for the elect; it is prepared for them before they ever arrive.
note: 70:5-7 do not exist (the live chapter is four verses); re-quoted live 70:3-4; Hebrews and Luke kept.

title: The dwelling with the Son of Adam, and the righteous who are not separated from him
summary_md: When Enoch's spirit is carried into the heaven of heavens he sees the house of fire and the ones who guard it: *And round about were Seraphin, Cherubin, and Ophannin: And these are they who sleep not And guard the throne of His glory.* (1 Enoch 71:7), *And I saw angels who could not be counted, A thousand thousands, and ten thousand times ten thousand, Encircling that house. And Michael, and Raphael, and Gabriel, and Phanuel, And the holy angels who are above the heavens, Go in and out of that house.* (1 Enoch 71:8). But the chapter does not end with the angels. It ends with the righteous, and where they will live: *And all shall walk in his ways since righteousness never forsaketh him: With him will be their dwelling-places, and with him their heritage, And they shall not be separated from him for ever and ever and ever.* (1 Enoch 71:16), *And so there shall be length of days with that Son of Adam, And the righteous shall have peace and an upright way In the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits for ever and ever.’* (1 Enoch 71:17). Enoch had just been set down among the first fathers in that same place: *And there I saw the first fathers and the righteous who from the beginning dwell in that place.* (1 Enoch 70:4), and earlier in the Parables he had seen their resting places and longed to stay: *Here mine eyes saw their dwellings with His righteous angels, And their resting-places with the holy. And they petitioned and interceded and prayed for the children of men, And righteousness flowed before them as water, And mercy like dew upon the earth: Thus it is amongst them for ever and ever.* (1 Enoch 39:5). This is the company the letter to the Hebrews names as the destination of the redeemed: *But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living Elohim (God), the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels, To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to Elohim (God) the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect* (Hebrews 12:22-23). The first fathers are the line of the covenant people gathered home to the Son of Adam, and their heritage is with him and never apart from him.
note: 71:7 was quoted in invented words and 39:6-7 was invented; re-formed on live 71:7-8, 71:16-17, 70:4, 39:5; Hebrews kept; degraded 'framework' line removed; title adjusted.

title: The secrets of the ends of the heaven — the chambers of the luminaries shown to Enoch
summary_md: Before Enoch sees the Head of Days, Michael takes him by the hand and shows him the hidden order of the heavens: *And the angel Michael [one of the archangels] seized me by my right hand, And lifted me up and led me forth into all the secrets, And he showed me all the secrets of righteousness.* (1 Enoch 71:3), *And he showed me all the secrets of the ends of the heaven, And all the chambers of all the stars, and all the luminaries, Whence they proceed before the face of the holy ones.* (1 Enoch 71:4). The chambers the lights go out from are the canon's own picture of how the Creator governs his world, the very thing Yahuah challenges Job to say he has seen: *Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail* (Job 38:22). Jeremiah names the wind drawn out of those same chambers: *When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures* (Jeremiah 10:13). And the same hand that keeps the storehouses appoints the lights, which is the order the book of the Luminaries will lay out next: *He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down* (Psalms 104:19). The hidden things Michael shows Enoch are nothing like the secret arts the Watchers sold to men. They are the Creator's own measured order, the stars and the lights and the winds each coming out of the chamber set for it.
note: 71:8 'storehouses of the winds' was invented; re-formed on live 71:3-4 (the secrets of the ends of heaven); Job, Jeremiah, Psalm kept; title adjusted.

title: The great luminary: the sun's rising, its chariot, and its circuit
summary_md: Enoch watches the sun go out first and traces its whole course through the portals: *And this is the first law of the luminaries: the luminary the Sun has its rising in the eastern portals of the heaven, and its setting in the western portals of the heaven.* (1 Enoch 72:2), *And first there goes forth the great luminary, named the Sun, and his circumference is like the circumference of the heaven, and he is quite filled with illuminating and heating fire.* (1 Enoch 72:4), *The chariot on which he ascends, the wind drives, and the sun goes down from the heaven and returns through the north in order to reach the east, and is so guided that he comes to the appropriate (lit. ‘that’) portal and shines in the face of the heaven.* (1 Enoch 72:5). Genesis had already crowned this greater light: *And Elohim (God) made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also* (Genesis 1:16). And David sings the same daily circuit through the same portals: *In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun, Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race. His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof* (Psalm 19:4–6). Enoch's portal tables are the map of the going forth and the circuit the Psalmist praises, and the chapter closes by saying whose order it is: *And that which (thus) rises is the great luminary, and is so named according to its appearance, according as Yahuah (Lord) commanded.* (1 Enoch 72:36). The sun runs its race the way it does because it was told to.
note: 72:4 was quoted in invented words; re-quoted live 72:2, 72:4-5 and added 72:36; Genesis and Psalm kept.

title: Her light given in measure — the moon, a faithful witness
summary_md: After the sun, Enoch is shown the law of the smaller light: *And after this law I saw another law dealing with the smaller luminary, which is named the Moon.* (1 Enoch 73:1), *And her circumference is like the circumference of the heaven, and her chariot in which she rides is driven by the wind, and light is given to her in (definite) measure.* (1 Enoch 73:2), *And her rising and setting change every month: and her days are like the days of the sun, and when her light is uniform (i.e. full) it amounts to the seventh part of the light of the sun.* (1 Enoch 73:3). Her light is given to her in measure, a seventh part at a time, and her first thin phase comes up with the sun on the thirtieth morning and fills out part by part from there. That regularity, month after month without a miss, is what makes her in Scripture a pledge that a covenant will hold: *It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.* (Psalm 89:37). The sage of the Apocrypha reads her the same way, as the appointed sign of the times: *He made the moon also to serve in her season for a declaration of times, and a sign of the world.* (Ecclesiasticus 43:6). The moon's reckoning never breaks because her light is measured out to her by the one who made her, and to keep the reckoning she keeps is to keep faith with him.
note: 73:3-4 quotes were invented; re-quoted live 73:1-3 (light given in measure); Psalm and Sirach kept; title adjusted.

title: Uriel shows the moon's course — the lights for signs and seasons
summary_md: Enoch is shown the moon's whole circuit by the angel who leads all the lights, and he writes down what he is shown: *And I saw another course, a law for her, (and) how according to that law she performs her monthly revolution.* (1 Enoch 74:1), *And all these Uriel, the holy angel who is the leader of them all, showed to me, and their positions, and I wrote down their positions as he showed them to me, and I wrote down their months as they were, and the appearance of their lights till fifteen days were accomplished.* (1 Enoch 74:2), *In single seventh parts she accomplishes all her light in the east, and in single seventh parts accomplishes all her darkness in the west.* (1 Enoch 74:3). None of this is a new cosmology. It is the fourth day of creation unfolded: *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:* (Genesis 1:14). The appointed times are written into the sky by the lights themselves. The Psalmist says the moon's reckoning is the Creator's own appointment and not something men came up with: *He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.* (Psalm 104:19), and the heavens are not quiet about whose work it is: *The heavens declare the glory of Elohim (God); and the firmament sheweth his handywork.* (Psalm 19:1). Enoch only spells out, portal by portal, what Genesis set in the sky and the Psalms confess. It ain't new.
note: 74:1 was quoted in invented words; re-quoted live 74:1-3; Genesis and Psalms kept.

title: The sun and the stars complete the year in 364 days
summary_md: Here the book of the Luminaries states the reckoning plainly, and shows where the moon falls short of it: *And if five years are added together the sun has an overplus of thirty days, and all the days which accrue to it for one of those five years, when they are full, amount to 364 days.* (1 Enoch 74:10), *And the overplus of the sun and of the stars amounts to six days: in 5 years 6 days every year come to 30 days: and the moon falls behind the sun and stars to the number of 30 days.* (1 Enoch 74:11), *And the sun and the stars bring in all the years exactly, so that they do not advance or delay their position by a single day unto eternity; but complete the years with perfect justice in 364 days.* (1 Enoch 74:12). The same number is sealed later in the book: *For they belong to the reckoning of the year and are truly recorded (thereon) for ever, one in the first portal and one in the third, and one in the fourth and one in the sixth, and the year is completed in three hundred and sixty-four days.* (1 Enoch 82:6). This is the order of whole days Genesis sets up when the lights are given for *days, and years* (Genesis 1:14). Jubilees guards the very same number and warns against letting the moon set the feasts: *For there will be those who will assuredly make observations of the moon–now (it) disturbs the seasons and comes in from year to year ten days too soon.* (Jubilees 6:36), and so that the feasts do not drift it commands the fixed count: *...so that they will not make the year three hundred and sixty-four days only, and for this reason they will go wrong as to the new moons and seasons and sabbaths and festivals...* (Jubilees 6:37). The sun and the stars carry the year; the moon is read against them, and six days a year she falls behind.
note: 74:10-12 were quoted in invented words; re-quoted live 74:10-12 and 82:6; Genesis and Jubilees kept; title adjusted (the live verses credit the sun and stars).

title: With perfect justice in 364 days — the feasts kept on time
summary_md: The chapter's reckoning ends on faithfulness rather than arithmetic: *And the sun and the stars bring in all the years exactly, so that they do not advance or delay their position by a single day unto eternity; but complete the years with perfect justice in 364 days.* (1 Enoch 74:12), *And the year is accurately completed in conformity with their world- stations and the stations of the sun, which rise from the portals through which it (the sun) rises and sets 30 days.* (1 Enoch 74:17). The lights do not advance or delay by a single day, and the whole point of that is so the appointed times arrive when they are supposed to. The feasts of Yahuah are fixed by the lights he set, not by men: *These are the feasts of Yahuah (LORD), even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.* (Leviticus 23:4). Jubilees seals it with the warning that the division of days is written on the heavenly tables for exactly this reason: *...for the book (lies) written before me, and on the heavenly tables the division of days is ordained, lest they forget the feasts of the covenant and walk according to the feasts of the nations after their error and after their ignorance.* (Jubilees 6:35). To complete the years with perfect justice is to keep faith with the one who ordered them, and to keep his reckoning is to keep his appointed times. It ain't new.
note: 74:13 was invented; re-formed on live 74:12 and 74:17; Leviticus and Jubilees kept; title adjusted.
